hero.headline: A system built to put *7-10 paid assessments* on Duende's calendar in your first 30 days

engine_intro: Your site says to call or text you directly, and your FAQ promises every minute is one-on-one with you, never an aide. That's exactly why new patients slip through: you can't pick up the phone halfway through a 75-minute evaluation. The engine keeps your personal touch and covers the gap. New ad leads, past patients and every missed call land with one AI agent that replies in seconds, in Duende's voice, and books the $49 assessment. Anyone who doesn't book, no-shows or finishes care gets recycled back into reactivation instead of forgotten.
step_blurbs: Ads put you in front of East Bay women who've been told to just do Kegels, pregnant and postpartum moms, and people who tried PT before and got a stock program.
Every click lands on a page about one thing, the $49 assessment, instead of a list of 70 conditions to scroll through.
The agent texts and chats with every lead in seconds, answers the insurance, superbill and internal-exam questions, and books the assessment.
Email and SMS campaigns to the leads and past patients you already have, so everyone who has trusted you with their care keeps booking visits.
Missed calls, no-shows and unbooked leads get followed up automatically, so nothing you paid for leaks out.

ads.headline: Ads built around the patients you're best at helping

close_intro: You've built a practice with 47 five-star reviews and a waitlist mindset. This puts it in front of more of the right people in the East Bay and makes sure every one of them gets an answer. Here's what we commit to.
chat_context:
Duende Physical Therapy + Pelvic Health, Berkeley, CA. Pelvic floor and orthopedic physical therapy. Solo practice: every visit is one-on-one with Dr. Natalia Martinez, DPT, never an assistant, aide or tech. Pronounced DWEHN-deh.

Clinician: Dr. Natalia Martinez, DPT. Doctor of Physical Therapy from Elon University, including a multi-month pelvic health clinical rotation and pelvic anatomy dissections. BA from Columbia University. Mentored in Fresno by women with decades of pelvic health experience. Continuing education since 2019 in pelvic health (Herman and Wallace Pelvic Floor Level 1, visceral mobilization of the urinary and GI systems, rectal evaluation and treatment, prolapse, endometriosis, pediatric pelvic floor, prostate cancer survivorship, constipation), advanced manual therapy (Institute of Physical Art) and hypermobility/EDS. Has been a PT patient herself many times. Queer Latina, offers trans-affirming, poly/ENM-friendly, sex worker-affirming and sex-positive care, respects religious and cultural preferences around modesty and touch.

What she treats: pelvic health (pelvic pain, urinary leakage, urgency and frequency, waking at night to pee, bladder pain syndrome/interstitial cystitis, UTI-like symptoms, constipation, fecal incontinence, painful sex, vaginismus, vulvodynia, pudendal neuralgia, prolapse, diastasis recti, penile, testicular and rectal pain, pre/post-prostatectomy, gender-affirming surgery pre/post-op, post-mastectomy, scar management); pregnancy and postpartum (birth preparation, pain in pregnancy, postpartum recovery, return to running, C-section scar, clogged ducts); orthopedics and sports (neck, back, SI joint, hip, knee, shoulder, elbow, wrist, ankle, sciatica, tension headaches, TMJ, whiplash, plantar fasciitis, tendinopathy, hypermobility, concussion, return to sport). Post-op orthopedic patients case by case.

Approach: relentlessly curious about what drives symptoms; trials a treatment, tracks the response, switches gears if it isn't helping. No stock programs, built around your activities and schedule. You decide when PT is done. Does not use EMG biofeedback machines, uses touch and coaching instead. Kegels may be unhelpful for some symptoms; strengthening is tailored to exam findings.

First visit: 75 minutes. Review forms, talk through concerns, physical assessment (strength, breathing, squatting, palpation). For pelvic concerns an internal vaginal or rectal exam may be recommended: always optional, only with consent, one gloved finger, no speculum or stirrups, can stop any time without explaining. Treatment and exercises may start the same day. Follow-ups are 50-55 minutes. Longer sessions possible. Sees pregnant patients (internal work from the second trimester). Postpartum: come as soon as ready; internal exam after medical clearance, usually 6-8 weeks. Kids and partners welcome; Pack 'n Play available. Fine to come on your period.

First step to book: the $49 assessment (normally $295), the full 75-minute evaluation, paid when booking, limited spots each month. This is what you book.

Pricing: evaluation normally $295, follow-ups $270. Sliding scale for household income at or below 500% of the federal poverty level (10-60% off, five slots a week). Cancellation: within 48 hours 50% charged, within 24 hours 75%, no-show full fee.
Insurance: out-of-network, does not bill insurance. Superbill provided for insurance, HSA or FSA reimbursement. Not a Medicare provider and by law cannot see Medicare patients for Medicare-covered services, even as cash pay. No referral needed in California (up to 12 visits or 45 days).

Location: 1911 Addison Street, Berkeley, CA 94704, ground floor, 6-minute walk from Downtown Berkeley BART. Metered street parking nearby; Promenade garage closes at 5pm. Serves the Bay Area (Oakland, Albany, El Cerrito, Richmond, Emeryville, Alameda, Walnut Creek, Orinda, Lafayette, San Francisco and more). Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5:30pm. Call or text (510) 949-4436, natalia@duendephysicaltherapy.com.

Rated 5.0 on Google (47 reviews). Real reviews: Daisy had urinary frequency, urgency and urethral pain for 8-9 years, saw many urologists without help, and Natalia helped her get better. Kristin saw 2 other providers over 8 months without help and felt relief after a few visits with Natalia.
